name: Sunny Pharmtech Inc.
summary: Based in Taoyuan, Taiwan, and established in 1994, Sunny Pharmtech Inc. focuses on the entire lifecycle of pharmaceutical products, from initial research and development to manufacturing and global sales. Its operations encompass both active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished medicinal products. The company's extensive product range includes: A lidocaine ointment, which functions as an anesthetic lubricant for intubation procedures and offers temporary relief from discomfort associated with minor burns, sunburn, skin abrasions, and insect stings. Cyanocobalamin injections, prescribed to treat vitamin B12 deficiency and pernicious anemia caused by malabsorption issues. Nitrofurantoin capsules, used in the treatment of urinary tract infections. Aminocaproic acid tablets, indicated for managing certain blood disorders and conditions involving excessive proteolytic enzyme activity. Carboprost tromethamine injections, utilized in therapeutic abortions and to address postpartum hemorrhage.
